title: Pocketful round-up savings MVP · Pocketful Ltd

input.brief:
Hey!

We're Pocketful, a pre-seed fintech in London. We want an MVP of a round-up savings app: users link their bank account (Open Banking via TrueLayer), every card purchase is rounded up to the nearest pound and the change is moved into a savings pot. Users can set goals, see progress, and withdraw.

Must-haves for MVP: iOS + Android app, onboarding with KYC (we'll use Onfido), TrueLayer integration, goals, a simple admin view for us, push notifications. Nice-to-have: an AI 'money coach' chat that gives savings tips.

We have a demo day with investors in 10 weeks so we need it live on TestFlight by then. Our budget is GBP 25k max, we can't go above that. Is this doable?

Cheers,
Sam Okafor, Co-founder

work_packages.name: Cross-platform mobile MVP and savings goals
work_packages.scope_notes: Build the English iOS and Android customer experience, including onboarding journey screens, savings goals and progress. Target an installable iOS TestFlight build and an Android build suitable for the agreed demo channel.

work_packages.name: Identity and bank account integrations
work_packages.scope_notes: Integrate Onfido KYC and TrueLayer bank connection for the agreed provider products and flows. High complexity reflects two unstaffed specialist integrations and unresolved account, event, verification and regulatory requirements; client must provide credentials, provider documentation and access.

work_packages.name: Round-ups, savings transfers and withdrawals
work_packages.scope_notes: Implement eligible-purchase round-up calculation, savings transfers and withdrawals against the confirmed funds flow and savings-pot provider. High complexity is warranted by regulated financial flows, and scope depends on the client's regulated entity, custody model, provider capabilities and handling rules.

work_packages.name: Staff admin view
work_packages.scope_notes: Provide a basic staff-facing web view for the specific user and service information needed for the MVP. Exact actions, access roles and audit needs must be agreed; avoid assuming broader operational workflows.

work_packages.name: Savings activity push notifications
work_packages.scope_notes: Send agreed app and savings-activity notifications, using the confirmed triggering events and user preferences.

risks.risk: TrueLayer purchase-data coverage, latency or event availability may not support the intended round-up model.
risks.mitigation: Validate eligible transaction types, account coverage, consent and event timing in the provider sandbox before fixing MVP behaviour; agree a fallback demo flow if necessary.

risks.risk: Funds movement, withdrawal and savings-pot responsibilities depend on the regulated entity and provider model, which are not yet confirmed.
risks.mitigation: Obtain written confirmation of the regulated party, permissions, safeguarding and funds flow before implementing live transfers; keep Empower's scope to software delivery.

risks.risk: TrueLayer and Onfido are not covered by in-house specialist experience.
risks.mitigation: Require client sandbox access, complete provider documentation, named provider support and early integration validation; allow for specialist review if needed.

risks.risk: The 10-week deadline and £25,000 cap may not accommodate the complete live end-to-end scope.
risks.mitigation: Define investor-demo acceptance criteria immediately, exclude the optional AI coach and phase non-essential operational functionality; estimate the must-have set before commitment.

risks.risk: The admin view, verification exceptions, notification triggers and withdrawal rules are underspecified.
risks.mitigation: Agree minimum workflows and acceptance criteria with Pocketful before implementation; treat material additions as change control.

risks.risk: UK GDPR and app-store/test-channel obligations could affect launch readiness.
risks.mitigation: Confirm data controller/processor roles, retention and access controls with Pocketful, and reserve time for TestFlight and Android distribution setup.

# Pocketful round-up savings MVP

**Prepared for:** Pocketful Ltd · **Prepared by:** Empower Solutions · **Date:** 2026-10-26

## Executive summary

We propose a phased MVP focused first on an investor-demo mobile journey, with TestFlight availability targeted for 3 January 2027. The current end-to-end estimate is 17.4 weeks, so the full requested scope cannot be delivered by the 4 January 2027 deadline. Phase 1 targets the deadline with onboarding screens, savings goals and progress; bank integrations, funds movement, the staff view and notifications should follow in Phase 2, subject to requirements and technical validation. The AI money coach is excluded from the MVP. Any delivery commitment and commercial scope should be confirmed against an approved estimate; the GBP 25,000 cap remains a client constraint to validate.

## Our understanding of your needs

Pocketful wants an iOS and Android savings MVP that rounds eligible card purchases up to the next pound and transfers the difference into savings. The requested experience also includes Onfido identity checks, TrueLayer bank connections, savings goals, withdrawals, a staff admin view and push notifications. The investor demo target is TestFlight availability within 10 weeks of 26 October 2026, with a stated maximum budget of GBP 25,000.

Important decisions remain open: who holds customer funds and operates the savings pot, the precise regulated responsibilities and funds flow, which provider products and transaction events are in scope, and whether the demo needs live end-to-end money movement. The current plan therefore separates the deadline-driven demo journey from integrations and financial activity that require confirmation and provider validation.

## Proposed approach

We recommend a phased delivery. Phase 1 targets 3 January 2027 with a narrowly defined React Native iOS and Android demo journey: onboarding screens, savings-goal creation and progress. Acceptance should specify the installable iOS TestFlight build and the agreed Android distribution channel. This phase does not imply live bank connectivity or money movement.

Phase 2 can add Onfido and TrueLayer sandbox flows, round-up and withdrawal demonstrations using simulated funds unless live activity is approved and supported, a minimum staff view, and a small agreed set of push notifications. The proposed technical foundation is React Native, a Node.js API, PostgreSQL, AWS, Next.js for the limited admin view and Firebase notifications. We will confirm journeys, test/live boundaries and acceptance criteria before delivery; validate provider access and product coverage early; and review regulated responsibilities with Pocketful and its advisers. An AI money coach is deferred.

### Technology

| Layer | Technology | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile app | React Native | Five people have the skill; it supports cross-platform delivery and has relevant project use. |
| Backend API | Node.js | Three people, all senior or lead, with multiple relevant past projects. |
| Database | PostgreSQL | Used in fintech project P105; capability is thin, with two people. |
| Cloud hosting | AWS | Strong in-house capability and relevant past-project use. |
| Admin web | Next.js | Six people have the skill; use only for the agreed minimum demo-facing staff view. |
| Push notifications | Firebase | Four people have the matched capability and it was used in savings MVP P123. |

### Work packages

| Package | What it covers |
|---|---|
| Demo mobile app, onboarding and savings goals | Build the smallest agreed iOS and Android customer journey: onboarding screens, savings goal creation/progress and the investor-demo path. Acceptance must identify the installable iOS TestFlight build and the agreed Android distribution channel; defer broader production readiness and any unconfirmed journeys. |
| Demo identity and bank connection | Include Onfido and TrueLayer only if Pocketful confirms these are essential to the investor demonstration and provides sandbox credentials, product configuration and provider support at kickoff. Otherwise the demo must use a clearly labelled test-data or simulated connection flow; no production integration is implied. |
| Round-up, savings and withdrawal demonstration | Demonstrate the agreed round-up calculation and savings/withdrawal journey using sandbox or simulated funds unless the regulated party and provider-supported live funds flow are confirmed in writing. Exclude live money movement until compliance, account coverage, transaction timing and custody responsibilities are settled. |
| Minimum staff demo view | Provide only the specific read-only user or demo status view Pocketful identifies as necessary for the investor demo. Exclude unrequested operational controls, complex permissions and audit workflows pending requirements and regulatory review. |
| Demo push notifications | Include only a small agreed set of savings-activity notifications if they are necessary to demonstrate the journey; otherwise defer. Acceptance should specify triggering events and supported demo devices. |

## Scope

**Included**

- Phase 1: agreed customer onboarding screens for the investor-demo journey.
- Phase 1: create savings goals and display progress.
- Phase 1: installable iOS TestFlight build and an agreed Android demo distribution channel.
- Phase 2, subject to confirmed requirements and access: sandbox Onfido identity and TrueLayer bank-connection demonstrations.
- Phase 2, subject to confirmed funds flow: round-up calculations and savings/withdrawal journeys using sandbox or simulated funds.
- Phase 2: a minimum staff-facing web view limited to agreed read-only user or demo status information.
- Phase 2, if needed for the demonstration: a small agreed set of savings-activity push notifications.

**Not included (can be quoted separately)**

- Live transfers, custody or operation of customer funds, and production money movement until responsibilities, compliance requirements, provider support and funds flow are confirmed in writing.
- Production-ready release, broader operational workflows, complex admin permissions and audit processes not yet specified.
- AI money coach.
- Any unconfirmed provider products, account types, transaction coverage, notification events or additional customer journeys.

## Timeline

| Discovery & design | 2 weeks | 26 Oct 2026 to 09 Nov 2026 |
| Build & test (iterative, demo every 2 weeks) | 13.4 weeks | 09 Nov 2026 to 11 Feb 2027 |
| UAT, launch & stabilisation | 2 weeks | 11 Feb 2027 to 25 Feb 2027 |

**Planned go-live:** 25 February 2027 (17.4 weeks from a start on 26 October 2026).

A dedicated project manager is your single point of contact, with daily overlap hours in your time zone.

## Commercials

We recommend **time & materials** for this project. Effort is estimated at about **2,020 hours**.

Empower has relevant experience with a real-time mobile wallet and a fintech savings MVP, alongside cross-platform mobile delivery. This experience is relevant to shaping a focused demo, while the proposed live integrations and regulated funds flow still require project-specific validation.
